    • Carne Asada Tacos Written from how we make it. The marinade is loosely based on Isabel Eats with cayenne and MSG added. The spice amounts, marinating time and quantities here are a starting point, not measured from our kitchen yet: adjust them after the next cook.
    • Moh's Duck and Tamarind Curry The paste is often too thick to blend, so we loosen it with some of the finishing water (usually about 500 ml / 2 cups) and add only what's left at the end. The total water stays at 750 ml.
